opportunities.title: Commercial Kitchen Exhaust (Hood) Cleaning Service
opportunities.idea: Deep-clean grease from commercial kitchen exhaust hoods, ducts and fans for restaurants, hotels, cafeterias, cloud kitchens. Compliance-mandated recurring service.
opportunities.why: Mandatory + recurring demand (fire-safety code; customer cannot DIY or skip). Net margins 25-40%. Low capex. India providers proven in Mumbai (OXY, Accordible) and Bangalore (deepcleaning.in, EPSCO).
opportunities.watchouts: Night/labour-heavy work; India fire-code enforcement less uniformly strict than US.

opportunities.title: Water Tanker / Bulk Water Supply (housing societies, construction, commercial)
opportunities.idea: Own/operate a small fleet of water tankers supplying bulk water to housing societies, construction sites, and industrial/commercial buildings.
opportunities.verdict: WEAK-MEDIUM (do not pursue as fresh entry)
opportunities.why: Rejected on live 2026 data. Demand is real (60%+ of Bengaluru depends on tanker water; Pune market ~23 cr/day), but BWSSB's Sanchari Cauvery scheme has already cut private tanker demand ~60% in some pockets, plus heavy price regulation, forced registration, and documented union/mafia behavior. Government is the competitor.
opportunities.watchouts: Kept as a documented negative example of why live 2026 data matters over pattern-based intuition.
